mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 in the same month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases > 100k, but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO is flat/declining, but 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
